name: Celestial Awakening gives an instant resurrect request the dead ally can accept (#9998)
contract: Celestial Awakening 803615 is a player-cast RESURRECT_NEW spell: 'Brings a dead ally back to life.
Cannot be cast when in combat.' The client disables the resurrect popup's Accept button while
GetCorpseRecoveryDelay() is above zero, and the server sends the corpse-reclaim delay (30/60/120 s) to
the victim on death. A player-cast resurrection request must carry the instant (0) overridden timer so
the victim can accept immediately; the corpse-reclaim delay then only governs running back to the body.
Fixture: a level-60 Starcaller casts 803615 on a dead, unreleased level-60 ally at the same location.

steps.label: Move the Starcaller away from the ally's corpse
SETUP: the caster is 10 yd from the corpse
Celestial Awakening on the dead ally
the caster completes the resurrection spell
DISCRIMINATING: the resurrect request carries the instant timer
DISCRIMINATING: the request also clears the corpse-reclaim delay
the ally is still waiting for consent
the accepted resurrection revives the ally
the ally is not left in combat
DISCRIMINATING: the ally revives at the corpse, not at the caster
